eveningSayTail: Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.

— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

🔥 Sari has been turning something over all evening. Finally: “Norman. The trade story — we all eat from the same pot here, we don’t get to lie about who’s at it.” It costs Sari to say it; you can see the price land.

Norman is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not Social worker — fishing guide. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.

Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
